notes: Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B (inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B rev 8d66b70a, MIT; code GitHub inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts 028c1eac): text to 44.1 kHz speech by a continuous-latent autoregressive loop (language model -> flow head -> aggregator per 80 ms latent, then the audio decoder). This file is the language model (Qwen2.5-0.5B, 24 layers; signatures 'prefill' = 64 prompt rows and 'step' = one row, the KV cache [1, 48, 511, 64] per K and V as graph input and output, the residual stream scaled by 1/4 and the stop head moved to the host). Published as litert-community/Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B (main d3fd65bc, last modified 2026-10-27T05:12:06Z; anonymous HTTP HEAD of each .tflite at that revision 2026-10-27 14:16 JST: x-linked-etag and x-linked-size = artifact_sha256 and the upload manifest); artifact_sha256 = the export record (716,899,024 B); the phone copies were not digested on the phone (the app's install pushed these bytes, `ls` on the phone shows the size). Records: one result per stage of a run (graph check, E5 bench, chain), the pipeline's numbers repeated in metrics. Placement names in the app: Q2D16 = default, Q4D16 = the faster all-NPU switch, Q2D16-gpu = the default on a phone without a Qualcomm NPU.
quantization: fp16 weights: litert-torch 0.9.4 float32 export with the weights cast to fp16 by ai-edge-quantizer 0.9.0 (FLOAT_CASTING, a DEQUANTIZE in front of each weight), fp32 activations
